confidence_notes: Reported 2026 food prices vary and local data are sparse: see [Wise](https://wise.com/us/cost-of-living/argentina/ushuaia) and the [Mundo Austral dining guide](https://mundoaustral.com.ar/blog/gastronomy-ushuaia-2026-en/). Cocktail and wine estimates follow their relationship to beer in a [local bar guide](https://consejosdeviaje.com/mejores-bares-ushuaia/). Accommodation figures are holistic July estimates; seasonality and currency changes add uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Ushuaia is estimated using the broader Patagonian tourism market, with adjustments for its remote location and winter ski demand.
